findings.title: No pytest oracle-gap (negative control) coverage for ground truth
findings.problem: GroundTruthTests exercise schema validation and command execution helpers but there is no automated test that applies a deliberately wrong cluster fixture and asserts GT checks fail—leaving weak checks undetected until manual review.
findings.evidence:
class GroundTruthTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Tests for ground_truth module helpers."""
findings.suggestion: Add integration-style tests with mocked subprocess outputs or temp configs where expect values intentionally mismatch, asserting run_all_checks reports FAIL; optionally add mutation-style variants of config_step checks in CI without calling live LLMs.
findings.impact: Ground truth can regress to 'pod running' style checks without CI catching loss of discriminative power.

findings.title: Report tests do not cover verification UNKNOWN path in summaries
findings.problem: generate_aggregate_report tests use verified True/False but do not assert behavior when verification ran but returned ambiguous status mapped into TestSummary (executor edge case).
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for _extract_execution_result or result_to_summary with result dict {"status": None, "verification_metrics": {...}} expecting verified None.
findings.impact: Regression in tri-state verification reporting could ship unnoticed.

findings.title: No golden harness smoke that ties RUN_DIR metrics to SQLite
findings.problem: metrics_db tests focus on pricing math and locking; none assert that a synthetic run writes consistent identifiers into both summary.json and metrics rows (once run_uuid exists).
